Name: NeonZuzuCity-- Expansion Mod
Author: PiratePapaya
Description:
This is a standalone mod, which you can think of as an interesting parallel version of Zuzu City from the [i]Stardew Valley[/i] setting. The mod adds multiple maps and NPCs, including places like the Pink Cake Shop.

I made an effort to keep the art style close the original while giving it a cyberpunk atmosphere. Future updates will add new dialogues, events, items, and more. This is a temporary test version, so some NPCs may not be able to accept gifts yet.

This mod requires you to use the Central Station to get to the location and doesn’t modify the town map or events, so it should be compatible with most other mods. You can reach Zuzu City via the train station. 

[b][i][u]Remember to get some sleep first—NPCs won't start moving until the next day.[/u][/i][/b]

Hope you enjoy the sights of Night City! Let me know if you’d like any changes.
